RNAmel: downstream bulk RNA-seq analysis platform

Source: R/RNAmel-package.R
RNAmel-package.Rd

RNAmel is a modular Shiny application packaged as an R package for downstream bulk RNA-seq analysis. It takes raw count matrices and sample metadata as input and provides:

Details

  • Differential expression analysis with DESeq2 (LFC shrinkage, independent filtering, custom contrasts)

  • Visualization: interactive volcano plots, publication-ready heatmaps, PCA scatter plots

  • Functional enrichment (phase 3): GSEA / ORA against MSigDB, GO, KEGG, Reactome

  • Co-expression network analysis (phase 4): WGCNA modules with trait correlations

  • Reproducible HTML reports (phase 5): Quarto-rendered summaries

Supports human, mouse and rat organisms.

To launch the app: RNAmel::run_app()
